title: 差分隱私查詢服務
summary: 以鄰接定義、敏感度與查詢預算串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect adjacency, sensitivity and query budgets with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 隱私定義
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「隱私定義」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop privacy definitions through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 保護單位：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「保護單位」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for protected units.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「保護單位」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：一筆紀錄與一位使用者可能不是同一鄰接單位。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「比較每人一筆與每人多筆的敏感度。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for protected units. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: A record and a person may be different adjacency units. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare sensitivity with one versus many records per person. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 比較每人一筆與每人多筆的敏感度。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare sensitivity with one versus many records per person. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：紀錄級 DP 自動等於使用者級 DP。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。

options: 紀錄級 DP 自動等於使用者級 DP。
一筆紀錄與一位使用者可能不是同一鄰接單位。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「保護單位」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Record-level DP automatically equals user-level DP.
A record and a person may be different adjacency units.
One matching output proves protected units for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.

quiz.explanationEn: A record and a person may be different adjacency units. Compare sensitivity with one versus many records per person. The alternative "Record-level DP automatically equals user-level DP." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.
